speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Could you please tell me your age and whether you have experienced any previous fractures or broken bones? Also, have you started menstruating yet?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of fractures and current use of isotretinoin, I need to rule out metabolic bone disease and assess for congenital adrenal hyperplasia. REQUEST TEST: Serum 17-hydroxyprogesterone, Serum Testosterone, Bone Mineral Density Scan.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the hormonal levels are normal, I need to investigate the cause of your bone fragility and physical features further. Do you have any family history of easy bruising, joint hypermobility, or similar skin issues?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Delayed menarche. I also have Severe acne, History of fractures following minor trauma, Partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly noted at birth.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal hormonal workup and history of fractures with minor trauma, I suspect a connective tissue disorder like Ehlers-Danlos syndrome. Do you have hypermobile joints or skin that is unusually stretchy or velvety to the touch?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Currently taking oral isotretinoin for acne and an oral contraceptive. Social history: The patient is a high school student without significant tobacco, alcohol, or drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to assess your bone health further given the fractures and normal hormonal results. REQUEST TEST: Serum Calcium, Serum Phosphorus, and Alkaline Phosphatase.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal metabolic and hormonal results, the combination of bone fragility, severe acne, and ambiguous genitalia at birth strongly suggests a defect in collagen synthesis. I will request imaging to assess the extent of your bone density and structural integrity. REQUEST IMAGES
